query:
-- Crop Calendar table
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS crop_calendar (
  id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
  crop_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  planting_date TIMESTAMP,
  estimated_harvest_date TIMESTAMP,
  actual_harvest_date TIMESTAMP,
  cumulative_gdd INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
  current_stage VARCHAR(100),
  gdd_to_maturity INTEGER,
  percent_complete DECIMAL(5, 2),
  is_on_track BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE,
  recommendations JSONB,
  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW() NOT NULL,
  updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW() NOT NULL
);

-- Pest and Disease Risks table
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS pest_disease_risks (
  id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
  crop_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  pest_or_disease VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL,
  type VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
  risk_level VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
  risk_score INTEGER NOT NULL,
  temperature DECIMAL(5, 2),
  humidity DECIMAL(5, 2),
  rainfall DECIMAL(7, 2),
  recommendation TEXT,
  assessment_date TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW() NOT NULL
);

-- Soil Moisture Readings table
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS soil_moisture_readings (
  id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
  crop_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  moisture DECIMAL(5, 3) NOT NULL,
  source VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
  depth INTEGER NOT NULL,
  quality VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
  reading_date TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW() NOT NULL
);

-- Irrigation Recommendations table
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS irrigation_recommendations (
  id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
  crop_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  should_irrigate BOOLEAN NOT NULL,
  urgency VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
  water_amount INTEGER NOT NULL,
  moisture_status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
  reason TEXT NOT NULL,
  next_check_date TIMESTAMP,
  recommendation_date TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  was_followed BOOLEAN,
  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW() NOT NULL
);
